author: GameTrailers
description:
The Immortal John Triptych is available now on Nintendo Switch 1, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. Check out the launch trailer for The Immortal John Triptych, a collection combining all 3 of Joe Richardson's jaunts into the life of The Immortal John, along with extras, quality-of-life improvements, console releases, support for multiple languages, and more.

The Immortal John Triptych features three Pythonesque adventures made from Renaissance paintings and reckless ambition. Pilfer from pirates, conspire with cardinals, and face the Four Last Things. Explore luscious landscapes and preposterous portraits in this gloriously silly, deeply intelligent trilogy.
title: The Immortal John Triptych - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out brutal multiplayer gameplay from Rock, Paper, Severed in this trailer for the upcoming game that combines 'Rock, Paper, Scissors', strategy, and psychological horror. The new trailer also showcases playable characters, items you can use during your throws, and more. Rock, Paper, Severed will be available on PC via Steam in 2026.
title: Rock, Paper, Severed - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam. Watch the Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters launch trailer for this anime soccer action game. In the sequel, Tsubasa Ozora once again represents Japan as they vie against national teams, including well-known soccer powerhouses, to advance to the highly contested World Youth Championship.
title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons. Get a fresh look at gameplay from Tempus Vitae in this new trailer for the upcoming sci-fi metroidvania FPS. Tempus Vitae will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. You can wishlist Tempus Vitae on Steam and PlayStation, and learn more about it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2360820/Tempus_Vitae/
title: Tempus Vitae - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Lou's Lagoon is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 1, Nintendo Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S. Step into the vibrant world, check out gameplay, and more from Lou's Lagoon in this launch trailer for the cozy adventure game. Lou's Lagoon takes players and their trusty seaplane across the tropical Limbo archipelago in search of Uncle Lou, missing after a nasty storm has hit. Along their journey, players will meet Limbo’s colorful residents, rebuild their storm-hit communities, and uncover the mystery of Lou’s disappearance.
title: Lou's Lagoon - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed announcement trailer for this upcoming remaster of the original remake of the action-platformer game, Volvy's Adventure. Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed will be available on Steam on November 19, 2026.

In Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, adventure across four revamped worlds full of naughty baddies and menacing boss fights while collecting delicious onions to keep Volvy at extreme levels of awesome! Whip out your big hand for whatever comes your way - from helicoptering over huge chasms and grinding radical rails to dashing through the skies and fisting your way deep underground. And just when you think you've met your match, scarf down a bundle of onions to transform into the muscular Swolvy and rage your way out of any situation.

There's some sort of story too. Basically some warlocks released some slime and Volvy is stopping them. Also, they kidnapped his friends.
title: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the demo announcement trailer for Glasshouse, an upcoming CRPG with turn-based combat from FLAT28. 

Set in a post-capitalist world on the brink of a terrible world-war, you play Wealdmaer, a deputy head of a condominium. Trapped in a crime-scene with no escape, you must manage the problems of the poor souls around you, and battle a political conspiracy that will turn your worldview upside-down! 

Glasshouse is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo releasing in October.
title: Glasshouse - Demo Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this all new look at Inferius! The first-person horror roguelike deckbuilder from Lucid Rain Studios. Venture into the nine dominions of hell as you flee from the infernal creatures that hunt your soul, as you seek to escape your torment by defeating the 9 avatars of the Inferno. 
Inferius is coming in 2027 for PC (Steam) with a demo available right now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470790/INFERIUS/
title: Inferius - Official Demo Release Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out 11 minutes of gameplay from Cassette Beasts 2002 in this video for the upcoming monster-collecting RPG sequel. Step into the realm of beasts, Nodnol, and watch as you transform from a beast back to a human and learn about this world. The new video showcases a battle and turn-based combat gameplay. 

In Cassette Beasts 2002, record, battle, and fuse with 250+ beasts as you adventure alongside diverse companions in this monster-collecting RPG. Set in London in 2002, play in single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist who threatens the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!
title: Cassette Beasts 2002 - Official 11-Minute Gameplay | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Bleeding Nightmare | 血に染まる悪夢 announcement trailer for this upcoming first-person narrative adventure about a young man trapped in Hell, looking for a way back home. Bleeding Nightmare will be available on PC (Steam), Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). You can wishlist on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161250/Bleeding_Nightmare

Knock three times in hidden places scattered across Hell to open your path forward. Sometimes the ghosts will answer, and sometimes the world around you will shift in unexpected ways.
title: Bleeding Nightmare - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Learn about the story and get a fresh look at Valor Mortis in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. The new trailer for Valor Mortis also gives us a peek at gameplay from this game starring Vincent Cassel as Napoleon. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity. Valor Mortis will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud, Steam, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on October 13, 2026.
title: Valor Mortis - Official Story Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out Combat Gameplay for Fable, an upcoming installment to the hit third-person action-adventure series developed by Playground Games. Players will get an extensive look at the game's core melee mechanics, element-based abilities, and an intense boss fight with the Lantern Keeper. Fable is launching on February 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).
title: Fable - Official Combat Gameplay | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: The Heaven & Abyss Update for Ark: Survival Ascended's Astraeos is available now on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. Watch the Ark: Survival Ascended Astraeos Heaven & Abyss update launch trailer to see what to expect with this update for the Greek mythology-themed DLC.
title: Ark: Survival Ascended Astraeos - Official Heaven & Abyss Update Launch Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a tour through peaceful, yet challenging locations in this latest Over The Hill trailer for the upcoming co-op racing adventure game. In Over The Hill, explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery. Over the Hill will be available on PC via Steam on October 14, 2026. It will also be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.
title: Over The Hill - Official Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Sniper Dan trailer for this upcoming funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a high-powered sniper rifle to solve low-stakes problems. Scope the scene, spot the problem, and shoot the solution. No violence. Just wholesome chaos and good intentions! The Sniper Dan trailer showcases gameplay and the funny, unexpected scenarios you'll uncover on your journey to help Clumsy County. Sniper Dan: Hotshot Edition features 19 exclusive gaming-inspired cosmetics, including a cozy gaming headset, goofy dragon statue, hotshot outfit, and more. 

Sniper Dan and Sniper Dan: Hotshot Edition will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on September 17, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Sniper Dan - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the vibrant world of Roco Kingdom in this trailer for the upcoming open-world monster-catching RPG. Roco Kingdom (launched in China in March 2026 as “Roco Kingdom: World") is a new evolution of an open-world creature-collecting game set within a magical kingdom that’s home to hundreds of unique and adorable creatures called Jinies. The game emphasizes creature collecting, open-world exploration, and monster battles (with fellow online players and NPCs alike). Roco Kingdom will be available on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and mobile. A closed beta test will be available beginning October 27, 2026.
title: Roco Kingdom - Official Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Join game director Eiichiro Sasaki for a look at the Wyvern boss battle from Stupid Never Dies in this latest trailer for the upcoming action-adventure game. Check out gameplay and get tips on how to defeat the formidable Wyvern boss, the dragon that rules the skies. The new video showcases the Wyvern's attacks and how protagonist Davy's strategy and abilities can change depending on gear. Stupid Never Dies will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Steam on October 21, 2026.
title: Stupid Never Dies - Official Wyvern Boss Gameplay with Dev Commentary Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at 11 minutes of gameplay from Join Us, an upcoming 1-4 player co-op open-world survival game. The gameplay video showcases character customization, exploration, activities, and more. In Join Us, start a doomsday cult of your very own. Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

Join Us will be available on Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Steam, and Epic Games Store in March 2027.
title: Join Us - Official 11-Minute Gameplay | gamescom 2026

title: Cassette Beasts 2002 - Official Developer Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Step into the boots of an unsung sporting hero in Kitman. Check out gameplay in the latest Kitman trailer for this 1-4 player sports management simulator set in the backrooms of a soccer stadium. In Kitman, run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan. Kitman will be available on PC. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4186890/Kitman

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for Hieronymus, an upcoming story-driven first-person action-adventure game. Explore the weird, surreal worlds of the medieval painter Hieronymus Bosch. Encounter grotesque creatures and make use of a variety of historical weapons and alchemy to unravel your family's mysteries.
title: Hieronymus - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Join actor Liam McIntyre (voice of Wolverine) for a deep dive into the features of Marvel's Wolverine in this latest trailer for the upcoming action game. The new trailer details combat, fighting techniques, story, the world, and more. Marvel's Wolverine will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) on September 15, 2026.
title: Marvel’s Wolverine - Official Game Features Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: New agents and more are coming to Zenless Zone Zero in Version 3.2. Check out the latest Zenless Zone Zero teaser trailer for a peek at what to expect from Version 3.2 of the urban fantasy action RPG. Zenless Zone Zero is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, PC, Xbox, and Steam. Version 3.1: The Long Goodbye is out now.
title: Zenless Zone Zero - Official Version 3.2: Their Secret Histories Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this trailer for There Are No Ghosts at the Grand, the story based renovation game developed by Friday Sundae. Rennovate an old decrepit hotel, and deal with the ghostly happenings that come from it. Featuring the voice talent of Billy Boyd, Alex Brightman and Ben Starr. 
There Are No Ghosts at the Grand is coming to early access in December 2026 for PC (Steam)
title: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand - Official Ben Starr Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at Extended Gameplay for GTA 6, the latest entry in the third-person open-world action-adventure Grand Theft Auto franchise developed by Rockstar Games. Players will return to a modern-day Vice City as Jason and Lucia embark on a thrilling adventure full of action, consequence, and hilarity, signature to the franchise. Check out a suite of gameplay clips from missions, dialogue sequences, combat, and more, all captured on PlayStation 5. Grand Theft Auto 6 is launching on November 19 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #Gaming
title: GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto 6) - Official Extended Gameplay
